scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional cash-out refinancing loan in the amount of $125,000 has been denied. This loan product type was Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you please tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what is my current interest rate and the total costs of this loan?
dialogue.agent: The primary reason for the denial of your loan application was that the credit application was incomplete. The record does not include an interest rate or total loan costs because the application was denied.

dialogue.user: I understand. Could you please tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Also, what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution. The record does not include a debt-to-income ratio because the application was denied.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have a few more questions. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: There are no high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on your loan. Your application was for a conventional cash-out refinancing loan.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now.

<Neutral> The agent provided the information I asked for, but I'm disappointed that my application was denied due to an incomplete credit application. I was hoping for a different outcome.
